translations.web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
translations.bsb: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
translations.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
translations.asv: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.
